_how_to: Add one object per villa to 'listings'. Copy the 'example' block, fill it in, and set status to 'available' (shown) or 'let' (hidden). Rent is in rupiah per month. pets: "no", "yes" or "ask" (owner decides case by case). Smoking is never allowed inside. Photos are full URLs (first one is the cover). Commit and it goes live on /monthly-rentals and in /listing-pack.

example.title: Four-bedroom pool villa, Pererenan
example.description: Quiet residential lane, five minutes to Pererenan beach. Enclosed living, full kitchen, private pool and staff quarters.
